history.summary: A 581 sqft 99-year leasehold 1BR in D23 Hillview at $1463 PSF / $850k, 460m from DT3 Hillview MRT. The appreciation rate is the most statistically robust in the batch (153 txns) — and it is essentially flat at ~0.8%/yr, a strong negative signal.
history.rating_rationale: A high-confidence 153-txn URA series shows just ~0.8%/yr appreciation — effectively flat for a decade, the clearest underperformance in the batch. The Hillier is a known mixed-use leasehold with persistent oversupply/weak demand; 99-yr tenure plus a 2016 build means lease decay is already in play. Lowest Elo (936) and worst record (100-194). The well-measured near-zero growth makes this an Avoid regardless of the convenient MRT.
